versions.changelog:
- No file changes detected in this version.
- Functionality and documentation remain unchanged from the previous release.

Initial release of the Find Skills skill.

- Helps users discover and install new agent skills based on their needs.
- Provides guidance on searching for, installing, and managing skills using the Skills CLI.
- Explains common use cases and categories to make skill discovery easier.
- Offers instructions for users to create their own skill if none exist for their requirement.
